newsitem.title: PERU: Peru electrical output rose 2.95 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Peru electrical output rose 2.95 pct in 1996.

text.p: Peru's electrical power output in 1996 rose 2.95 percent to 16,381 gigawatt hours (GWh), compared with 15,911 GWh the previous year, Energy and Mines Ministry said Thursday.
Public service firms accounted for 13,028 GWh, while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 3,353 GWh of the country's total output.
State-run Electroperu, the largest of Peru's power- generating public service firms, produced 7,336 GWh in 1996, down 14.94 percent compared with the previous year.
